Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent.json

Interface JsonCodec

public interface JsonCodec
Converts between JSON text and plain Java values.

The value model is Map<String, ?> for objects, List for arrays, String, Boolean, null and numbers.

Implementation Requirements:
Implementations must be safe to share across threads, must throw JsonException for every failure, and must never put the input text or a value into an exception message.

  • Method Details

    • encode

      String encode(Object value)
      Encodes a value as compact JSON with every non-ASCII character escaped as a six-character unicode escape.
      Parameters:
      value - the value; null encodes as null
      Returns:
      the JSON text
      Throws:
      JsonException - when the value, or anything nested in it, is unsupported, not finite, or nested deeper than the codec allows (which is how a cyclic structure fails)

    • decode

      Object decode(String text)
      Decodes JSON text into plain Java values.

      Objects decode to a mutable LinkedHashMap in first-seen key order; for a duplicate key the last value wins. Arrays decode to a mutable List.

      Parameters:
      text - the JSON text
      Returns:
      the decoded value, null for JSON null
      Throws:
      JsonException - when the text is null or is not valid JSON

    • encodeUnescaped

      default String encodeUnescaped(Object value)
      Encodes a value like encode(Object) but keeps non-ASCII characters as they are, matching Laravel's json:unicode cast.

      Quotes, backslashes, control characters, U+2028 and U+2029 are still escaped.

      Parameters:
      value - the value; null encodes as null
      Returns:
      the JSON text
      Throws:
      JsonException - when the value cannot be encoded
      Implementation Requirements:
      The default delegates to encode(Object), so a codec that does not override it escapes everything.
